name: Google Agent Skills
works_with: Agents supported by npx skills, plus plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI
short: Google's own AI skills for Google Cloud, GKE, BigQuery, Firebase, Gemini APIs, Google Ads and more.
what: Google's collection of agent skills for its products, mostly Google Cloud. It covers onboarding and authentication, GKE, BigQuery and other databases, Cloud Run and Firebase, monitoring and logging, security and IAM, the Well-Architected Framework, the Gemini APIs and Genkit, and the Google Ads and mobile ads SDKs. The repo also bundles plugins that pair skills with MCP servers.
who: Developers and platform engineers working on Google Cloud or with Google's developer APIs. If you don't use Google products, skip it.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Pick specific skills or all of them, the agents to set up, and project or global scope.

steps.title: Or add the plugins in Claude Code
steps.text: Then install the one you want with `claude plugin install <plugin>@google-plugins`.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: Using the Cloud Run basics skill, walk me through deploying this app to Cloud Run.

watch: The README lists over 150 skills. The installer lets you choose only the ones you need.
The plugins bundle MCP servers as well as skills.
Skills for Android, Flutter, Dart, Firestore, Google Maps and ADK live in other repos. The README links to them.
